source: Iowa State University Extension and Outreach, Ag Decision Maker File A2-33, 'Cost of Storing Grain' (FM 1816, rev. May 2023, pp. 1-2)
reason: ISU File A2-33 (pp. 1-2) gives cents/bu ranges for on-farm storage (converted at corn's 39.368 bu/t), while exact commercial elevator rental rates in companion spreadsheet a2-33.xlsx and grain-bagging file a3-10.pdf returned HTTP 403.

own_silo.source: Iowa State University Extension and Outreach, Ag Decision Maker File A2-33, 'Cost of Storing Grain' (FM 1816, rev. May 2023, pp. 1-2: existing farm bin ownership costs are sunk = 0; extra handling 2.0-2.5 c/bu midpoint 2.25 c/bu * 39.368 bu/t = 0.89 USD/t; aeration fan electricity 0.2-0.3 c/bu midpoint 0.25 c/bu over ~6 months = 0.02 USD/t/month; handling and storage shrinkage 0.5-1% midpoint 0.75%)
own_silo.reason: A2-33 (pp. 1-2) reports cents/bu ranges rather than crop-specific USD/t point quotes; midpoints were converted at corn's 39.368 bu/t (soybean at 36.744 bu/t would be 0.83 USD/t fill) and exclude extra drying below 13%.

silo_bag.source: FACMA, 'Precios Orientativos: Embolsado y Extracción' (31 Aug 2026, p. 1 table: 11.30 USD/t); Olivanti (2012) citing INTA (p. 2 table: 6 months low-risk window for dry grain)
silo_bag.reason: ISU grain-bagging publication (File A3-10) returned HTTP 403; provisional contractor service cost and 6-month dry-grain life taken from FACMA (2026-08, p. 1) and Olivanti/INTA (2012, p. 2), excluding bag film purchase.

elevator.source: Iowa State University Extension and Outreach, Ag Decision Maker File A2-33, 'Cost of Storing Grain' (FM 1816, rev. May 2023, pp. 1-2: quality deterioration and shrink in commercial storage are covered by the elevator's storage charge)
elevator.reason: A2-33 (p. 1) confirms zero storage shrink to the farmer at a commercial elevator, but exact Iowa commercial rental dollar charges are in companion spreadsheet a2-33.xlsx (HTTP 403); retains the legacy 2.0 USD/t/month provisional rate.
